imp0.title: Number of targeted population who achieve sustained employment/income as a result of Municipality-facilitated economic opportunities
imp0.who: Municipal M&E focal point, by telephone or site visit
imp0.when: At each follow-up round once the beneficiary reaches the X-month point; reported at end of project
imp0.calc: A COUNT, not a rate: unique beneficiaries (by National ID) whose engagement is confirmed as sustained for at least X consecutive months. Counted once only, whatever the number of trainings or support mechanisms accessed. Target: 65 persons over 3 years. OPEN ITEM: the Action Plan writes the calculation formula as a ratio; confirm with ENABEL that a count is what is reported.
imp0.disaggregation: Gender; age; nationality; vulnerability category; type of pathway

national_id.label: National ID
national_id.help: The unique key for de-duplication across all forms.

age_years.label: Age
age_years.help: Disaggregation. Record the number; the age bands are derived when reporting.

vulnerability.label: Vulnerability category
vulnerability.help: Disaggregation. Select all that apply - a person can fall in more than one.

pathway_id.label: Through which Municipality-facilitated opportunity did this person FIRST access economic support?
pathway_id.help: Disaggregation by type of pathway, following the Action Plan's categories. Record the FIRST access only.

pathway_refs.label: Reference of that opportunity
pathway_refs.help: Links this record back to the output form that first registered the person. Every pathway option above has an identifier here, including the internship or facilitated interview route, which is traced through the Event or Session ID.

first_access_month.label: Month and year of first access
first_access_month.help: The clock for the X-month rule starts here.

engaged_id.label: Are you currently engaged in paid employment, self-employment or an income-generating activity?
engaged_id.help: Do NOT skip the months question below when the answer is "No, I stopped". Someone who was engaged for 12 months and stopped last month still meets the definition.

capacity_id.label: In what capacity are you engaged, or were you engaged?
capacity_id.help: Daily or casual labour counts only where it has been continuous, per the Action Plan's exclusion of short-term, temporary and one-off engagements.

consecutive_months.label: Number of CONSECUTIVE months engaged, with no break of a month or longer
consecutive_months.help: Record the number, not a band, so the criterion below can be applied whatever value of X is agreed. For someone who has stopped, record the months completed before stopping.

stopped.label: If no longer engaged: month and year of stopping, and main reason
stopped.help: Optional - for learning and programme management. Not part of the indicator count.

imp0_criterion_id.label: Sustained engagement criterion met?
imp0_criterion_id.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT. It must follow arithmetically from the months field above. OPEN ITEM: agree the value of X with the Municipality before first use.

imp0_verification.label: How was this verified, and what is on file?
imp0_verification.help: Self-report alone is the weakest source; seek at least one documentary item where possible.

counted_under_id.label: Has this National ID already been counted for this indicator in a previous round?
counted_under_id.help: Prevents double counting. Each beneficiary is counted once only, per the Action Plan.

so10.title: # of persons who demonstrate increased employability as a result of municipality facilitated networking opportunities
so10.who: Municipal M&E focal point, by telephone follow-up
so10.when: Three to six months after the event attended
so10.calc: Count of unique persons meeting the employability threshold: a confirmed placement, OR at least one VERIFIABLE action (interview attended, offer received, internship or placement started, enrolled in training) plus one further action from the checklist. Counted once per person. OPEN ITEM: confirm this threshold with the Municipality - the Action Plan's equivalent result indicator counts confirmed employment only.
so10.disaggregation: Gender; age; nationality; vulnerability category; type of event attended

national_id.label: National ID
national_id.help: De-duplication key; must match the event attendance sheet.

event_id.label: Which event is this follow-up attributed to?
event_id.help: One event only. This is the key for the type-of-event disaggregation.
event_id.sub: Single Event ID (RMTH-EV-...) or Session ID (RMTH-VG-...)

event_date.label: Date of that event
event_date.help: Follow-up should be at least three months after this date.

other_events.label: Any other Municipality-facilitated events attended since?
other_events.help: Optional - for learning and programme management. Not part of the indicator count.

reached_id.label: Was the person reached?
reached_id.help: Those not reached are excluded from the count and from any rate. Record the attempts.

so10_verifiable_step.label: Since attending, which VERIFIABLE steps have you taken?
so10_verifiable_step.help: At least one item here is required to meet the threshold. These can be checked against an employer, host or training record.

so10_other_step.label: Since attending, which other steps have you taken?
so10_other_step.help: Self-reported. One item here, alongside one verifiable step above, meets the threshold.

current_status_id.label: What are you doing now?
current_status_id.help: The first four options count as a confirmed placement, which meets the threshold on its own.

so10_threshold_id.label: Employability threshold met?
so10_threshold_id.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT. It must follow from the three questions above, not be judged separately.

counted_under_id.label: Has this National ID already been counted for this indicator?

enumerator.label: Enumerator name and date of contact

a12.title: # of networking events including job fairs
a12.who: Municipal officer who organised or co-organised the event
a12.when: Within one week of the event; reported quarterly
a12.calc: Count of documented networking events conducted. Each event is counted once. A combined event contributes 1 here AND 1 to RMTH-SO1-A1.3; the two indicators must never be added together, because the Action Plan treats them as one indicator with a single target of 4 per year.
a12.disaggregation: Type of event; gender and age of participants

solely_guidance.label: Is this event solely a vocational guidance session?
solely_guidance.help: THIS FIELD DECIDES WHETHER A RECORD BELONGS HERE, AND SO PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT: every record answering No counts as one event. A COMBINED event is recorded here and also as a session under RMTH-SO1-A1.3; the two indicators are then reported separately, never summed.

opts.false: No - it is a networking event, record it here
opts.true: Yes - record it under RMTH-SO1-A1.3 instead and do not create a record here

employers_count.label: Number of employers or companies taking part
employers_count.help: An event recorded as a networking event or job fair should have at least one employer present.

attendees.label: Number of attendees
attendees.help: Gender disaggregation of participants is required by the Action Plan.

age_bands.label: Age breakdown of attendees
age_bands.help: Same bands as the person-level forms, so event and person data can be reconciled.

a12_evidence.label: Evidence on file
a12_evidence.help: Attendance sheet and photographs are the minimum named by the Action Plan. The attendance sheet must carry National IDs so attendees can be followed up under RMTH-SO1-0.

a13.title: # of vocational guidance sessions
a13.who: Municipal careers officer or the facilitator who delivered the session
a13.when: Within one week of the session; reported quarterly
a13.calc: Count of documented vocational guidance sessions delivered. Each session is counted once. A session held inside a larger networking event still counts as 1 here, and that event counts as 1 under RMTH-SO1-A1.2; the two indicators must never be added together.
a13.disaggregation: Topic of the session; target group; gender and age of participants

reference.label: Session ID
reference.help: EVERY COMPLETED RECORD PRODUCES ONE UNIT OF THE INDICATOR COUNT: one session, one record, one ID. There is no further screening field, so do not open a record for a session that was cancelled or did not take place.

parent_event_id.label: Was the session standalone, or part of a larger event?
parent_event_id.help: Record the parent Event ID so the two records can be reconciled. Do NOT create a second RMTH-SO1-A1.2 record for this session.
parent_event_id.sub: Part of a larger networking event - parent Event ID

attendees.label: Number of participants
attendees.help: Gender disaggregation is required by the Action Plan.

age_bands.label: Age breakdown of participants
age_bands.help: Same bands as the person-level forms.

a13_evidence.label: Evidence on file
a13_evidence.help: The attendance sheet must carry National IDs so participants can be followed up under RMTH-SO1-0.

b1.title: % of supported project implementers reporting that at least one component of municipal support was essential to their ability to operate
b1.who: Municipal M&E focal point, by interview with the implementer
b1.when: Six to twelve months after the project began operating
b1.calc: Numerator: implementers rating at least one support component 'Essential'. Denominator: implementers who received at least one component of municipal support, were approached, and responded. Implementers not reached or refusing are excluded from both. An implementer running several approved projects is counted ONCE. Multiply by 100.
b1.disaggregation: Sector; project type; type of support component

sections.s1: SUPPORT COMPONENTS AND HOW CRITICAL EACH WAS

first_record_of_id.label: Is this the first record for this implementer?
first_record_of_id.help: The denominator counts implementers, not projects. An entity running three approved projects enters the denominator once.

proposal_ids.label: Approved proposal / project ID(s) held by this implementer
proposal_ids.help: Links to the approval records under RMTH-SO1-B1.2.

project_type_id.label: Project type
project_type_id.help: Disaggregation. Where the implementer holds several projects, record the main one.

respondent.label: Respondent name, role and phone
respondent.help: The respondent must be someone who runs the project day to day.

reached_id.label: Was the implementer reached?
reached_id.help: Only completed interviews enter the denominator.

enters_denominator.label: Enters the denominator?
enters_denominator.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE DENOMINATOR. Derive it from the three fields above rather than leaving them to be combined at tabulation. Complete the support grid first, then return to this field.

support.label: Support-criticality grid: for EACH component below, record whether it was received and, if so, how important it was to the implementer's ability to operate
support.help: Lay this out as a grid, one row per component, before digitising. The per-component ratings are what give the type-of-support-component disaggregation; a single free-text cell will not hold them.

received_any.label: Did this implementer receive at least one component of municipal support?
received_any.help: An implementer who received nothing cannot be asked whether anything was essential.

any_essential.label: Was at least one component rated 'Essential'?
any_essential.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE NUMERATOR. It must follow from the grid above, not be asked separately.

most_essential_component_id.label: Which single component was the most essential?
most_essential_component_id.help: Disaggregation by type of support component.

would_have_helped.label: If no component was essential, what support would have made the difference?
would_have_helped.help: Ask only where the answer above is No. Optional - for learning and programme management. Not part of the indicator count.

operating_status_id.label: Is the project currently operating?
operating_status_id.help: Ability to operate is the subject of the indicator, so this is the context for the rating.

b11.title: # of specialized training programmes (industrial, agricultural, or administrative) tailored to the technical requirements of the approved projects
b11.who: Municipal training focal point, with the partner that co-developed the content
b11.when: On completion of programme development; reported quarterly
b11.calc: Count of programmes meeting BOTH tests: (a) specialisation is industrial, agricultural or administrative, AND (b) the programme is documented as tailored to the technical requirements of at least one approved project. Each programme is counted once.
b11.disaggregation: Specialisation; sector of the linked project; partner type

specialisation_id.label: Specialisation
specialisation_id.help: Only industrial, agricultural and administrative programmes count towards this indicator.

occupation.label: Occupation or skill set targeted
occupation.sub: (open text, for example CNC operator, greenhouse technician, warehouse clerk)

proposal_ids.label: Which approved project(s) does this programme serve?
proposal_ids.help: Required. A programme with no linked approved project does not count towards this indicator.

linked_sector_id.label: Sector of the linked project(s)
linked_sector_id.help: Disaggregation. Use the same list as RMTH-SO1-B1.2 so the two can be cross-tabulated.

b11_requirements_method.label: How were the project's technical requirements identified?
b11_requirements_method.help: At least one method must be documented for the programme to qualify as tailored.

requirements_document.label: Reference of the requirements document
requirements_document.help: This is the evidence that the programme is tailored rather than generic.

tailoring_met.label: Tailoring criterion met?
tailoring_met.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT.

opts.true: Yes - linked to an approved project and requirements documented

hours_modality.label: Total hours and modality
hours_modality.help: Minimal programme identity, so the reference can be matched to delivery records.

b11_evidence.label: Evidence on file
b11_evidence.help: The Action Plan names training material as the evidence for programme-development indicators.

b12.title: # of proposals approved for implementation
b12.who: Secretary of the municipal review or investment committee
b12.when: At each committee decision; reported quarterly
b12.calc: Count of proposals with a decision of 'Approved for implementation' or 'Approved with conditions'. Proposals deferred, rejected or still under review are recorded but not counted. Each proposal is counted once, on first approval.
b12.disaggregation: Sector; sub-sector; proposal type; type of submitting entity

reference.label: Proposal ID
reference.help: On approval this same ID becomes the Project ID used by RMTH-SO1-B1 and RMTH-SO1-B1.1.

submitter.label: Submitted by
submitter.help: Disaggregation by type of submitting entity.

b12_support_requested.label: Municipal support requested
b12_support_requested.help: Feeds the support-component grid in RMTH-SO1-B1.

decision_id.label: Decision
decision_id.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT. Only the first two options count.

approval.label: Approving body and decision reference
approval.help: The decision reference is the primary evidence for this indicator.

conditions.label: If approved with conditions, what are the conditions?
conditions.help: Optional - for learning and programme management. Not part of the indicator count.

b12_evidence.label: Evidence on file
b12_evidence.help: The Action Plan names municipality reports, photographs and testimonials as evidence for the equivalent project indicator.

so20.title: % of training completers placed into employment or an internship within three months of completing the cycle
so20.who: Municipal M&E focal point, by telephone follow-up
so20.when: Three months after each training cycle ends
so20.calc: Numerator: completers whose placement into EMPLOYMENT OR AN INTERNSHIP started within three months of the cycle end date. Denominator: completers on the RMTH-SO2-C1.2 roster for that cycle who have reached the three-month point and were reached for follow-up. Multiply by 100. OPEN ITEM: confirm with the Municipality whether self-employment counts as a placement; the indicator statement says employment or internship.
so20.disaggregation: Gender; age; nationality; vulnerability category; training cycle; type of placement

national_id.label: National ID
national_id.help: Must match the completion record under RMTH-SO2-C1.2.

cycle_end.label: Date the cycle was completed
cycle_end.help: The three-month window is counted from this date.

three_month_reached.label: Has the three-month point been reached?
three_month_reached.help: Only completers past the three-month point enter the denominator.

reached_id.label: Was the person reached?
reached_id.help: Those not reached are excluded from the denominator. Record the attempts so the response rate can be reported alongside the percentage.

so20_placement_type.label: Since completing the cycle, have you been placed in any of the following?
so20_placement_type.help: Employment, internship, on-the-job placement and apprenticeship count. Self-employment is recorded separately in the numerator field below pending the Municipality's decision.

placement_start_month.label: Month and year the placement started
placement_start_month.help: Compare with the cycle end date to apply the three-month rule.

so20_outcome_id.label: Placement outcome within three months of completing the cycle
so20_outcome_id.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE NUMERATOR. Keeping self-employment on its own line means the numerator can be recomputed either way once the Municipality decides.

facilitated_by_id.label: Was the placement facilitated by the Municipality or its partners?

obstacle_id.label: If not placed, what is the main obstacle?
obstacle_id.help: Optional - for learning and programme management. Not part of the indicator count.

so20_verification.label: How was the placement verified, and what is on file?
so20_verification.help: Self-report alone is the weakest source; seek one documentary item where possible.

so2c1.title: % of trainees who report that training offered supported their employment journey
so2c1.who: Municipal M&E focal point, by telephone or at a follow-up session
so2c1.when: Three to six months after the training cycle ends
so2c1.calc: Numerator: trainees answering 'Yes, significantly' or 'Yes, to some extent' to the headline question. Denominator: trainees on the RMTH-SO2-C1.2 completion roster for the cycle who were approached AND reached. Those not reached or refusing are excluded from both. Multiply by 100.
so2c1.disaggregation: Gender; age; training cycle; type of support reported

national_id.label: National ID
national_id.help: Links to the completion record under RMTH-SO2-C1.2.

cycle_id.label: Training cycle reference, title and completion date

reached_id.label: Was the trainee reached?
reached_id.help: Every trainee on the completion roster must have a record here, reached or not. Only those reached enter the denominator; report the response rate alongside the percentage.

headline_id.label: Overall, did the training support your employment journey?
headline_id.help: THIS SINGLE QUESTION PRODUCES THE NUMERATOR: the first two options count. The denominator is set by the contact-outcome field above.

so2c1_support_way.label: In what way did the training support you?
so2c1_support_way.help: Ask only where the headline answer is Yes. This gives the type-of-support disaggregation.

why_not_id.label: If the training did NOT support your employment journey, why not?
why_not_id.help: Ask only where the headline answer is No. This is what tells the Municipality what to change.

so2c1_evidence.label: Evidence on file
so2c1_evidence.help: The completion roster is what fixes the denominator, so it must be filed with the feedback records for the cycle.

c11.title: # of short-term intensive training cycles delivered whose content was jointly developed with private sector establishments and academic or vocational institutions
c11.when: On completion of each cycle; reported quarterly
c11.calc: Count of cycles meeting BOTH tests: (a) short-term intensive per the agreed definition, and (b) content jointly developed with at least one private sector establishment AND at least one academic or vocational institution, with documentary evidence. OPEN ITEM: fix the short-term intensive thresholds with the Municipality before first use.
c11.disaggregation: Sector or occupation; partner type; delivery modality

reference.label: Cycle reference
reference.help: This reference is used by RMTH-SO2-C1.2, RMTH-SO2-C1 and RMTH-SO2-0.

intensity.label: Duration and intensity
intensity.help: Record the raw numbers so the short-term intensive test below can be applied whatever thresholds are agreed.

short_term_intensive.label: Does the cycle meet the agreed definition of short-term intensive?
short_term_intensive.help: Write the agreed thresholds here once fixed with the Municipality, for example "no more than X weeks and at least Y contact hours per week", and derive this answer from the numbers above.

private.label: Private sector establishment(s) that took part in developing the content
private.help: At least one private sector establishment is required for the cycle to count.

academic.label: Academic or vocational institution(s) that took part in developing the content
academic.help: At least one academic or vocational institution is required for the cycle to count.

c11_joint_evidence.label: Evidence of joint development
c11_joint_evidence.help: At least one documentary item is required. Verbal involvement alone does not qualify.

joint_development_met.label: Joint development criterion met?
joint_development_met.help: THIS FIELD, TOGETHER WITH THE SHORT-TERM INTENSIVE TEST, PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT.

opts.true: Yes - at least one private sector establishment AND one academic or vocational institution, with documentary evidence

trainees.label: Number of trainees
trainees.help: Completers are recorded individually under RMTH-SO2-C1.2; these totals are the reconciliation check.

c12.title: # of trainees completing training programs related to employability
c12.who: Trainer or municipal training focal point, at the end of each cycle
c12.when: At the close of each cycle; reported quarterly
c12.calc: Count of records where 'Did this person meet the completion criteria?' is Yes. The Action Plan defines a completer as someone who completes the training AND is assessed as job-ready. Report BOTH figures: total completions, and unique completers by National ID (the de-duplication field below gives the second).
c12.disaggregation: Gender; age; nationality; vulnerability category; type of training

phone.label: Phone number
phone.help: Required for the three-month placement follow-up under RMTH-SO2-0 and the feedback survey under RMTH-SO2-C1.

tests.label: Pre-test and post-test scores
tests.help: The Action Plan names pre/post survey results as the evidence for this indicator.

job_ready.label: Assessed as job-ready by the trainer?
job_ready.help: The Action Plan defines a completer as someone who completes AND is assessed as job-ready. There is deliberately no 'partially' option, because a middle answer cannot be counted.

employer_eval.label: For on-the-job trainees: employer evaluation received?
employer_eval.help: The Action Plan names employer evaluations as a data collection method. A trainer cannot assess an on-the-job trainee; the host employer does.

met_criteria.label: Did this person meet the completion criteria?
met_criteria.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT. Write the agreed rule here before first use, for example "Yes only where attendance is at least 75%, the final assessment is Passed, and job-ready is Yes". OPEN ITEM: confirm the rule with the Municipality.

counted_under_id.label: Has this National ID already completed a cycle counted under this indicator?
counted_under_id.help: Lets the Municipality report unique completers as well as total completions, and feeds the de-duplicated impact count.

opts.first: No - this is a first completion

so30.title: # of persons who secure regular income as a result of Municipality-supported/facilitated entrepreneurship programming
so30.who: Municipal M&E focal point, by telephone or site visit
so30.when: Annually, and at each follow-up round after support
so30.calc: Count of unique persons (by National ID) confirmed to be earning income from a supported enterprise in at least four of the last six months. Counted once per person. OPEN ITEM: confirm the four-of-six-months rule with the Municipality.
so30.disaggregation: Gender; age; nationality; vulnerability category; sector; type of support received

so30_support.label: Which entrepreneurship support did this person receive?
so30_support.help: Disaggregation by type of support. Training on incubator design is NOT listed here: it equips staff to run incubators and does not make its participants entrepreneurs.

support_refs.label: Reference of that support
support_refs.help: Incubated enterprises already carry an RMTH-EN number from RMTH-SO3-E0.2. For a household enterprise, supported micro or small business, or a trainee who never entered an incubator, issue the RMTH-EN number here, once per enterprise.

enterprise.label: Enterprise or activity name and sector

role_id.label: Role of this person in the activity

earning_since_month.label: Month and year the activity started earning

months_of_six.label: In how many of the last six months did you earn income from this activity?
months_of_six.help: This is what makes the income 'regular'. Record the number, not a band.
months_of_six.sub: Number of months out of six

so30_criterion_id.label: Regular income criterion met?
so30_criterion_id.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT. It must follow from the number above.

income_change_id.label: Compared with before the support, is your income from this activity higher or lower?
income_change_id.help: Optional - for learning and programme management. Not part of the indicator count.

stopped.label: If income has stopped, when and why?
stopped.help: Optional - for learning and programme management. Not part of the indicator count.

so30_verification.label: How was the income verified, and what is on file?
so30_verification.help: Seek at least one source beyond self-report where possible.

counted_under_id.label: Has this National ID already been counted for this indicator?

e01.title: # of specialised business incubators in high-impact fields such as urban development, infrastructure, food manufacturing, and professional services established
e01.who: Municipal focal point for economic development
e01.when: At each stage of establishment; reported quarterly
e01.calc: Count of incubators that are (a) specialised in a high-impact field and (b) confirmed as established and operational against criteria 1 to 5 below. Following the Action Plan definition, admission of a first cohort is tracked but is NOT required for the incubator to count as established.
e01.disaggregation: Specialisation field; host arrangement; partner type

sections.s1: ESTABLISHMENT CHECKLIST (CRITERIA 1 TO 5 DECIDE THE COUNT)

field_id.label: Specialisation field
field_id.help: A general-purpose incubator with no specialisation does not count towards this indicator.

partners.label: Partner institutions and their role
partners.help: The indicator specifies collaboration with universities and the private sector. Disaggregation by partner type.

c1.label: 1. Physical or virtual space identified and prepared

c3.label: 3. Operational plan and service catalogue in place

services_live.label: 5. Core incubation services launched
services_live.help: The Action Plan requires initiation of core incubation services. Two live services is the threshold, so criterion 5 can be read off rather than judged.
services_live.sub: Services live (select all, with the date each began)
services_live.criterion: Criterion 5: two or more services live - met; one service live - not met; no service live - not met

established_id.label: Is the incubator established and operational?
established_id.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT. Only 'Achieved' is counted.

cohort.label: First cohort admitted
cohort.help: Tracked for programme management and to link to RMTH-SO3-E0.2. Not a condition of the count.

e01_evidence.label: Evidence on file
e01_evidence.help: The Action Plan names photographs and the project report as evidence for the incubator.

e02.title: # of participants receiving incubation services
e02.who: Incubator focal point, from the service log
e02.when: On admission and updated at each service; reported quarterly
e02.calc: Count of unique participants (by National ID) who have received at least one incubation service. Counted once per participant, however many services they receive.
e02.disaggregation: Gender; age; nationality; vulnerability category; sector; type of service; enterprise stage

phone.label: Phone number
phone.help: Required for the regular-income follow-up under RMTH-SO3-0.

incubator_id.label: Incubator ID and name
incubator_id.help: Links to the incubator record under RMTH-SO3-E0.1.

enterprise_id.label: Enterprise ID
enterprise_id.help: One ID per ENTERPRISE, not per person: where two co-founders are admitted, the first record issues the ID and the second reuses it. An enterprise that never enters an incubator is given its RMTH-EN number on the RMTH-SO3-0 form instead.

admitted_on.label: Date of admission or first service
admitted_on.help: This date places the participant in a reporting quarter.

stage_id.label: Stage of the enterprise at admission

e02_service.label: Which incubation services has this participant received?
e02_service.help: At least one service must be recorded for the participant to be counted. Disaggregation by type of service.

counted_under_id.label: Is this the participant's first time receiving incubation services from the Municipality?

opts.first: Yes - count as a new unique participant

status_id.label: Current status in the incubator
status_id.help: Optional - for learning and programme management. Not part of the indicator count.

e03.title: # of participants trained on incubator design
e03.who: Trainer or municipal training focal point
e03.when: At the close of each cycle; reported quarterly
e03.calc: Count of records where 'Did this person meet the completion criteria?' is Yes. Report BOTH total completions and unique participants by National ID.
e03.disaggregation: Gender; age; type of organisation; role of the participant

organisation.label: Organisation and role
organisation.help: The key dimension for this indicator: who is being equipped to design and run incubators. Disaggregation by type of organisation and role.

cycle_id.label: Training cycle reference and title
cycle_id.help: RMTH-ID is the prefix for incubator-design cycles, distinct from RMTH-TC employability cycles and RMTH-EP entrepreneurship programmes.

modules.label: Modules covered
modules.help: This is the content check for the indicator, not an optional extra: at least one design module must be recorded, otherwise the cycle is not a training on incubator design and the participant is not counted.

met_criteria.label: Did this person meet the completion criteria?
met_criteria.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT. The rule must include the content test: at least one incubator-design module recorded above. Write the full agreed rule here before first use, for example "attendance at least 75%, post-test at least 60, and at least one design module covered".

counted_under_id.label: Has this National ID already been counted for this indicator?
counted_under_id.help: Lets the Municipality report unique participants as well as total completions.

opts.first: No - this is a first completion

f01.title: # of participants trained in entrepreneurship training
f01.who: Trainer or municipal training focal point, at the end of each programme
f01.when: At the close of each programme; reported quarterly
f01.calc: Count of records where 'Did this person successfully complete the training?' is Yes. The Action Plan defines these as participants who successfully complete training on production practices, quality standards and basic management skills relevant to their enterprise type. Report BOTH total completions and unique participants by National ID.
f01.disaggregation: Gender; age; nationality; vulnerability category; type of training; enterprise stage

phone.label: Phone number
phone.help: Required for the regular-income follow-up under RMTH-SO3-0.

cycle_id.label: Programme reference and title
cycle_id.help: Links to the programme record under RMTH-SO3-F0.2.

f01_training_type_id.label: Type of training
f01_training_type_id.help: Disaggregation by type of training, as required by the Action Plan.

enterprise_status_id.label: Enterprise status at the start of the training

enterprise_sector_id.label: Enterprise type or sector
enterprise_sector_id.help: The Action Plan requires the content to be relevant to the participant's enterprise type.

f01_module.label: Modules completed
f01_module.help: Production practices, quality standards and basic management are the three the Action Plan names explicitly.

met_criteria.label: Did this person successfully complete the training?
met_criteria.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT. The rule must include the content test from the Action Plan: at least one of production practices, quality standards or business management must appear in the modules completed above. Write the full agreed rule here before first use, for example "attendance at least 75%, final assessment Passed, and at least one of the three named module areas completed".

counted_under_id.label: Has this National ID already been counted for this indicator?
counted_under_id.help: Lets the Municipality report unique participants as well as total completions.

opts.first: No - this is a first completion

f01_evidence.label: Evidence on file
f01_evidence.help: The Action Plan names attendance sheets and completion certificates as the evidence.

f02.title: # of training programs developed for entrepreneurship
f02.who: Municipal training focal point, with the partner that developed the content
f02.when: On completion of programme development, and updated at each delivery; reported quarterly
f02.calc: Count of programmes where 'Programme development complete?' is Yes. Each programme is counted once. OPEN ITEM: the Action Plan defines the equivalent indicator as the number of training SESSIONS delivered, each counted once regardless of participants. The delivery log below records every cycle so the number can be reported either way once ENABEL and the Municipality agree which reading governs.
f02.disaggregation: Sector; type of training (modality); target group and level; partner type

reference.label: Programme reference
reference.help: This reference is used by RMTH-SO3-F0.1 and RMTH-SO3-0.

f02_content_basis.label: What was the content based on?

source_document.label: Reference of the needs assessment or source document
source_document.help: The evidence that the programme was developed, not merely relabelled.

f02_module.label: Modules included
f02_module.help: Should match the modules recorded as completed under RMTH-SO3-F0.1.

f02_material.label: Which materials have been produced?
f02_material.help: A programme counts as developed when the curriculum and at least the trainer guide exist.

development_complete_id.label: Programme development complete?
development_complete_id.help: THIS FIELD PRODUCES THE INDICATOR COUNT under the programme reading.

deliveries.label: Every delivery of this programme
deliveries.help: Add a row each time the programme is delivered. This log is what allows the indicator to be reported as sessions delivered, per the Action Plan definition, as well as programmes developed.

deliveries_total.label: Total deliveries to date
deliveries_total.help: The figure to report if the Action Plan's session-based reading governs.

f02_evidence.label: Evidence on file
f02_evidence.help: The Action Plan names training material as the evidence for this indicator.
